items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: She was working for Joan Crawford, movie star, at the Modise.

ctx.x: And she was the one that was instructing me, because, see, Gladys had got her schooling from Benny Goodman, because Benny Goodman hired her to come and take care of him. That was the last alternative. And I heard this out of her mouth. She told that in Columbus, Ohio. And she was working for Joan Crawford, movie star, at the Modise.
Oh, that's what she was doing.
